The '''Allied Tion sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was one of three sectors making up the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], along with the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] and the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]].

==History==
Circa [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], what became the Allied Tion was part of the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion]] and [[Jaminere Marches]], some of many fiefdoms that formed the remnants of the empire of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot.<ref name="Xim Week" /> Most of the worlds of the Allied Tion were settled during the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]] or in the early period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Mission to Lianna" /> The region that became the Allied Tion was traditionally a buffer between the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] and the worlds of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], with the worlds of [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], [[Barseg]], [[Cadinth]] and [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]] jostling for influence.<ref name="Xim Week" />

The Tion Cluster joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] circa [[23,900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and in the Republic's final years, the Cluster became divided between the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] and the [[Kingdom of Cron]]. Both these states joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> Several battles were fought here during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the sector was contested between the Separatists and the Republic.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] paid for its support for the Confederacy when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] carved new sectors out of its territory to minimize the risk of Separatism. This resulted in the Allied Tion sector, but the region had little historical identity.<ref name="Xim Week" /> The region became known for its manufacturing and trade, and the Allied Tion was actively patrolled by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], including the [[Warlord (Victory II-class)|''Warlord'']], because of the volume of trade passing along the [[Cadinth Run]], and also because of its vital strategic importance to the Empire, both as a supply base and because of its location on the main [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="Mission to Lianna" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the sector and the entire Cluster integrated into [[Zsinj's Empire]]. They stayed under [[Zsinj]]'s control until [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|his death]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], claiming independence from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], including during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />

Following the death of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the sector was under the rule of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Gronn]].<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Astrography==
[[File:Allied_Tion_sector.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The Allied Tion sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The capital of the sector was [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]], but the best known planet in the Allied Tion was [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], home of [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]]. Other major planets in Allied Tion include [[Cadinth]] and [[Lorrad]].<ref name="Mission to Lianna" />

The [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] passed through the Allied Tion in three [[Star system/Legends|star systems]],<ref name="Xim Week" /> making the sector significant both as a trading hub and link between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and as a strategic area.<ref name="Mission to Lianna" /> The Allied Tion's main intra-sector route was the [[Cadinth Run]], though little of its traffic passed beyond [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]] to [[Dravione]] and the [[Desevran Trace]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

==Economy==
During the Old Republic, the Allied Tion became the most active sector of the Cluster. During the Empire, it was a seat of manufacturing and trade, and almost 15% of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]] hailed from the sector, presumably as part of [[Santhe Passenger and Freight]]. Indeed, the Allied Tion was dominated by the [[Santhe Corporation/Legends|Santhe/Sienar]] corporate family, based on Lianna.<ref name="Mission to Lianna" />
